tokens.name: void
tokens.usage: Material 01. Application exterior, negative space, landing scenes, the deepest background layer. Carries Phantom White at 18.8:1.

tokens.name: obsidian
tokens.usage: Material 02. The primary shell material: navigation, shell framing, large workspace surfaces. Platinum reads at 12.1:1 here.

tokens.name: carbon
tokens.usage: Material 03. Slightly elevated structure: major panels, dashboards, command regions.

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: Material 04. The functional interactive surface: tool cards, controls, menus, drawers, selected structural areas.

tokens.name: gunmetal
tokens.usage: Material 05. Strong neutral architecture: inactive controls, separators, elevated frames, panel seams. A hairline, not a perceivable control edge — that is platinum-mute.

tokens.name: smoked-glass
tokens.usage: Material 06. Dark translucent overlay for command palettes, floating utility panels and contextual HUD layers. Always over a backdrop blur, always with an opaque fallback. Blur is secondary — this is not a glassmorphism system.

tokens.name: platinum
tokens.usage: Material 07. The primary metallic neutral: technical labels, important icons, neutral controls, instrumentation. The default text colour.

tokens.name: platinum-dim
tokens.usage: Platinum at lower energy. Supporting copy, column headers, units, inactive rail labels. 6.0:1 on carbon.

tokens.name: platinum-mute
tokens.usage: Platinum at its lowest readable energy. Perceivable control edges, engraved marks, disabled glyphs, 24px-and-up metadata. 3.5:1 on carbon — clears 3:1 for edges, never body text.

tokens.name: phantom-white
tokens.usage: Material 08. Maximum information contrast, used sparingly: primary headings, active values, critical system output.

tokens.name: sovereign-gold
tokens.usage: The primary Phantom brand metal. Emblem, major structural lines, section identifiers, premium controls, important navigation architecture. Gold is precious — too much of it destroys its authority, so it is never a generic highlight.

tokens.name: deep-gold
tokens.usage: Recessed gold: secondary borders, the shadow side of a metallic edge, a gold node's seat.

tokens.name: highlight-gold
tokens.usage: Reflective highlight. Extremely sparing — emblem illumination and high-value selected states only.

tokens.name: blood-crimson
tokens.usage: Atmospheric Phantom crimson: environmental depth, warning illumination, danger-adjacent structure. Too dark for text at 2.3:1 on carbon.

tokens.name: signal-crimson
tokens.usage: Higher-energy crimson for alert emphasis: danger edges, destructive control borders, critical rails. 3.9:1 on carbon — an edge and fill colour, not a text colour. Danger text uses bright-crimson.

tokens.name: bright-crimson
tokens.usage: The Bright step of the crimson family, added so danger can be written as well as drawn. 7.0:1 on carbon. Error text, failed status labels, destructive button labels.

tokens.name: deep-blood
tokens.usage: Background atmosphere and warning depth. The ground behind a critical alert, never a surface that carries body text.

families.command: "Bahnschrift", "DIN Alternate", "Avenir Next Condensed", "Segoe UI Variable Display", system-ui, sans-serif
families.interface: "Inter", "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif
families.technical: "JetBrains Mono", "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, monospace

styles.name: system-title
styles.usage: The system mark on landing and portal screens. Uppercase, expanded tracking, once per screen.

styles.name: operator-title
styles.usage: Operator identification in the masthead and on entry. Always carries the operator code after the double slash.

styles.name: section-header
styles.usage: Section identifier, uppercase, usually sitting on a Phantom Line. The one place uppercase is routine.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: The working-context title of a workspace.

styles.name: panel-header
styles.usage: Panel, card and drawer headings. Short and direct.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Imaging halts if the source reports an unrecoverable read.
styles.usage: Interface copy, in platinum. Measure capped at 72 characters.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Dense rows, card descriptions, secondary copy.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, field labels, menu items, table headers.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Instrumentation numerals. Tabular figures, tight leading, a micro-label beneath — never a marketing metric.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Paths, hashes, identifiers, addresses, build strings. Never long descriptive prose.

styles.name: telemetry
styles.usage: The telemetry rail, meter readouts, log lines.

styles.name: micro-label
styles.usage: Engraved identifiers on panel architecture: STATE, TARGET, BUILD, NODE. Used sparingly — this is the marking on the machine, not a heading.

spacing.note: A 4px base grid. Dense does not mean cramped: density changes the step you reach for, never the legibility of what sits in it.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; the inset on a micro-label; a rail's breathing room.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside a control; between adjacent controls; dense table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Standard row padding; compact component interiors.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding; the default gap between modules.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between content groups; comfortable panel padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections; the workspace gutter.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Major page divisions.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Command region separation on the home workstation.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Landing and operator-selection negative space. Darkness is structure — this step is where it lives.

radius.note: Phantom geometry is cut, not rounded. Radii stay near zero; the recognizable corner is the Phantom Cut, which is a chamfer rather than a radius.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Panels, rails, tables, frames — anything structural.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, toggles and small controls.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Cards and menus. The largest radius in the system.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status dots and the toggle knob. Nothing else.

geometry.note: The Phantom Cut: a diagonal chamfer on the upper-right or lower-left corner, cut with clip-path. Applied to important panels, operator cards, command modules, modal architecture and large buttons — never to every element.

tokens.name: cut-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and compact cards.

tokens.name: cut-md
tokens.usage: Standard panels, tool cards, command modules.

tokens.name: cut-lg
tokens.usage: Modal architecture, hero panels, the operator matrix.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: The operator-energy rail on a selected card, row or nav item.

tokens.name: node-size
tokens.usage: The gold node in a Phantom Line.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Panel seams, card edges, table rules, control borders at rest.

tokens.name: border-edge
tokens.usage: An illuminated operator edge on an active or selected surface.

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus outline. Never replaced by glow.

tokens.name: focus-offset
tokens.usage: Offset between a control's edge and its focus outline.

layout.note: Five zones: masthead, navigation rail, workspace, context panel, telemetry rail.

tokens.name: masthead-height
tokens.usage: The command masthead. Controlled height — part of the machine, not a website header.

tokens.name: rail-expanded
tokens.usage: Navigation rail with icon and label.

tokens.name: rail-collapsed
tokens.usage: Navigation rail as icons only.

tokens.name: context-panel
tokens.usage: Right-hand context panel. Collapses when unnecessary.

tokens.name: telemetry-height
tokens.usage: The bottom system telemetry rail.

tokens.name: row-comfortable
tokens.usage: Comfortable density: landing, operator selection, settings, onboarding.

tokens.name: row-standard
tokens.usage: Standard density. The default for dashboards, tool browsers and the command center.

tokens.name: row-dense
tokens.usage: Dense: logs, networking, diagnostics, forensic tables, inventory.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum workspace width; technical tables may exceed it and scroll.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum line length for interface copy.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur behind smoked glass. Subtle, and always with an opaque fallback.
